title: llama.cpp
before: Running a model meant Python, CUDA and a datacentre GPU.
problem: Most people have a laptop, not an A100.
breakthrough: A dependency-free C++ inference engine with quantized weights, running LLaMA on a CPU or a MacBook.
why: It created local inference as a mass activity, and GGUF became the format the whole local ecosystem shares.
next: Ollama and the local-model tooling built on top of it.
inherits: The assumption that you can run a capable model on your own machine.
